messages.content: I'm planning a camping trip and I need to know the weather forecast. Can you fetch me the weather data for the campsite located at latitude 35.68 and longitude -121.34 for the next 10 days including daily temperature and precipitation forecasts? Also, I prefer the temperature 2 minute max in Fahrenheit and sum of precipitation in inches.

function.name: play_artist
function.description: Initiates playback of the specified artist's music on the user's default music player. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

artist_name.description: The name of the artist whose music is to be played.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to retrieve live weather data. You could check a reliable weather service (e.g., the National Weather Service, Weather.com, or a weather API like OpenWeatherMap) for a 10‑day forecast at latitude 35.68 N, longitude ‑121.34 W. Those services will give you daily maximum temperatures (you can convert to Fahrenheit if needed) and precipitation totals (which you can sum to get inches).

They want temperature 2 minute max in Fahrenheit and sum of precipitation in inches. We need to fetch weather data. There's no built-in function for weather. The only function available is play_artist. So we cannot fetch weather. We must respond that we can't fetch weather. Possibly we can suggest using an API or provide approximate info.
